newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee up as funds buy after varied day.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee up as funds buy after varied day.

text.p: LIFFE coffee futures ended a varied day at or near highs amid fund buying, traders said.
Coffee jumped at the open, but then lost much of its gains as buyers held back, fearing a repeat of Friday's late losses.
Helped by New York's rises it recovered slowly later, until a round of fund buying pushed prices up in the later stages of the afternoon.
Active May last traded at $1,600, up $55. May volume was 2,305 lots of a total 4,596.
But traders were sceptical about the likelihood of a renewed sharp rise.

"I wouldn't like to see it race away and fail like it has twice in the last couple of days," one said. He expected coffee to consolidate at around current levels, before gathering strength for a renewed assault on highs.
"I still think it will go a bit higher, but first it has to trade around these levels," he said.
Traders said the market was unwilling to get itself in the position where it ends up with sharp falls, repeating Friday's late sharp drop.
"I think a lot of people got stung," the trader said.

New York coffee futures erased opening losses and jumped to fresh life-of-contract highs early Monday as speculators bought heavily amid positive technical indicators and a threatened strike by state workers in Colombia.
